export_method: Selected baseline Git files with explicit deployment-sanitized derivatives; unused duplicate ICL launch data omitted for the standard XPL adapter.

portability.scope: Source subset with deployment-sanitized legacy ICL factory/host. Native evaluator, planner, transport and algorithm bytes are unchanged.

deployment_sanitization.scope: Legacy ICL factory accepts any explicit nonempty model; host resolves service/model through required environment variables. Policy effort, budgets, transport and evaluator behavior are unchanged. Provider-specific comment generalized without changing executable statements.
deployment_sanitization.identity_contract: Legacy factory requires the environment model to match its prepared identity; launch rejects subsequent model drift.

icl_materialization_diagnostics.scope: Failure-only bounded diagnostics for ICL materialization checksum mismatches, including relative paths and current source/target SHA256 and bytes. Copying, integrity rejection, publication, native evaluation and action algorithms are unchanged.

icl_copy_read_integrity.scope: ICL copies hash actual target read bytes against the source file size observed immediately before copying. Only premature EOF retries from byte zero at most three times with 0.05-second intervals; oversized reads fail immediately, and each read rechecks independent regular-file identity without following links. Persistent short reads reject the copy. Manifest SHA comparison, motion algorithms and native evaluator are unchanged.
